snippet.title: Street Fighter 6 - Alex Update Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Alex Update now and work the crowd in Street Fighter 6!

🤼‍♂️ Wrestle with Alex's Combo Trials and Character Guide
☀️ Catch some rays with the release of Dee Jay and Elena's Outfit 4
🏋️ Find new strength with an updated battle balance

The weights are off. You ready?

Alex can be obtained individually with Fighter Coins, and the owners of the Year 3 Character Pass / Ultimate Pass will automatically get access to Alex when he releases.

https://www.streetfighter.com/6/

#StreetFighter6 #SF6 #Alex #Capcom
